Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Thomas and I are excited to kick off a 6-week pilot. Procurement asked me to confirm onboarding requirements. What we can provide immediately: completed vendor intake form, W-9, SOW signed by our CEO (attached draft), and proof of insurance. We can route invoices to our finance team (invoices@brightedgeanalytics.com) on Net 30. Let me know what additional evidence your team needs to approve a temporary no-PO onboarding.

Appreciate the help — we want to get the pilot started next Monday if possible.

Kyle / Priya — forwarding BrightEdge inbound. They want to run a 6-week pilot (~$18.2k) and are asking for onboarding without a PO.

Recommended conditional approach (proposal):
- Approve a temporary no-PO exception for pilots under $25k with a 90-day limit.
- Require completed vendor intake form, W-9, proof of insurance and a signed SOW via DocuSign before any work begins.
- Invoices must cite the exception ID and be sent to AR (invoices@redwood.ai).
- Finance to confirm GL code and create a vendor record; Procurement to log the exception in the procurement tracker and set a reminder for 90-day review.

If Marcus signs off from Finance and Priya from Legal/Procurement, I’ll confirm to BrightEdge and send the DocuSign link. I attached the intake form I’ll ask them to fill out.

Thanks,
Hannah

Hi Rachel — great to connect. Quick summary and next steps so we can get you onboarded for Monday: 

1) Conditional approval: Finance has approved a temporary no-PO exception for the 6-week pilot (exception ID PROC-EX-2027-047). This covers up to $25,000 total and will automatically expire 90 days after execution.

2) Required items before kickoff (please upload to the DocuSign link below or reply with attachments):
   - Completed vendor intake form (attached template)
   - Signed SOW (DocuSign link below)
   - W-9 (W9_BrightEdge.pdf)
   - Certificate of insurance (general liability)

3) Invoicing: Submit invoices to invoices@redwood.ai; invoices must reference PROC-EX-2027-047 and include the following fields: billing contact, vendor remit address, and Redwood GL code (we will provide). Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt.

4) Procurement & tracking: Priya will create the vendor file and log the exception. We’ll run a 90-day review and either convert to a standard PO process or close the vendor record.

DocuSign (SOW): https://app.docusign.com/brightedge/signon/0A1B2C3D4E5F
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/DEAL-2027-0047

Please send the three requested documents by end of day Wednesday and we’ll finalize the intake. If anything changes on your side for timelines, flag it — we can shift the start date but need docs before any billable work.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
